games.title: Capital Cities
about: See a country on its map and flag, then spot its capital among three city cards: how big, how high, by the sea or a lake, what lies around. Play straight away; quizzes and flashcards are there if you want to learn more.
howTo: Pick a set of countries.
Look at the map and flag, then tap the city you think is the capital.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points. Build a streak for stars.

games.title: Find It on the Map
games.tagline: Put every country in its place.
about: Find countries on the map of the world, of each region and among the small countries, with hot-and-cold hints or against the clock.
howTo: Read the name of the country.
Tap the map where it is.
Closer taps score more.

games.title: Country Sizes and Populations
games.tagline: Which is bigger? Guess, then sort.
about: See a country on its map and flag, then guess how big it is or how many people live there: three values, one is right, the others are two to four times off. Play straight away; sorting and estimating sets are there if you want more.
howTo: Look at the map and flag.
Tap the area or population you think fits.
A wrong value greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Neighbours and World Regions
games.tagline: Who borders whom, and where it lies.
about: See a country on its map and flag, then spot the country next door among three shapes: only one shares a land border with it. Play straight away; the true or false sets and flashcards are there if you want more.
howTo: Look at the map and flag.
Tap the country that shares a border with it.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Which Animal Lives Here?
games.tagline: Read the map, spot the animal.
about: A map shows the countries where an animal lives. Tap the animal that lives there: its class, size and conservation status are on the card. Every play draws new animals from the whole world, or choose mammals or birds.
howTo: Look at the range on the map.
Tap the animal you think lives there.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Which River or Lake?
games.tagline: Follow the water across the map.
about: A map shows the countries a river runs through, or that border a lake or sea. Tap the water that belongs there: its kind, length or size and depth are on the card. Every play draws new waters from the whole world, or choose rivers or lakes.
howTo: Look at the countries on the map.
Tap the river or lake you think belongs there.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Which Mountain Is This?
games.tagline: Spot the peak or volcano by its country.
about: A map shows the country where a mountain or volcano stands. Tap the mountain that belongs there: its kind, height and, for volcanoes, type and last eruption are on the card. Every play draws new mountains from the whole world, or choose peaks or volcanoes.
howTo: Look at the country on the map.
Tap the peak or volcano you think stands there.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: What's the Weather Like?
games.tagline: Pin a city, pick its climate.
about: A pin on the map shows a city. Tap the climate zone that fits it: rainforest, desert, steppe, cold winter... The answer gives the city's measured average temperature and yearly rain. Every play draws new cities from the whole world, or choose a climate group.
howTo: Look at the pin on the map.
Tap the climate zone you think fits.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Which Food Comes From Here?
games.tagline: From dumplings to cheeses: find the home country.
about: A country shows on its map and flag. Tap the dish or cheese that comes from there. Every play draws new foods from the whole world, or choose dishes or cheeses.
howTo: Look at the country and its flag.
Tap the food you think comes from there.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Which Language Is Spoken Here?
about: A country shows on its map and flag. Tap an official language of that country: each card names the script it is written in. Every play draws new countries from the whole world, or choose a continent.
howTo: Look at the country and its flag.
Tap a language you think is official there.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.

games.title: Where Did It Happen?
games.tagline: Launches, flights, expeditions and quakes by country.
about: A country shows on its map and flag. Tap the space launch, first flight, expedition or natural event that belongs to it: each card gives its kind and year. Every play draws new events from the whole world, or choose launches, flights or natural events.
howTo: Look at the country and its flag.
Tap the event you think belongs to it.
A wrong card greys out: try again for fewer points.
